message.content:
We're investigating how the BASE (unmodified) Salesforce PWA Kit's wishlist page actually handles a shopper removing an item — specifically whether the UI updates optimistically (the item disappears immediately, before the server confirms) or waits for the server mutation to resolve (e.g. shows a loading/spinner state first) — needed for a future integration wiring a Zimmermann-built ZimmProductCard's `onRemove` callback into the real wishlist removal flow. This is pure research: report facts with exact file:line citations and quoted source, do not write or modify any code, do not guess.

Please investigate and report back:

1. Read `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/account/wishlist/index.jsx` in full (or the relevant remove-handling section if the file is large) and find the actual remove-item handler. Quote the exact code.

2. Identify which hook/mutation it calls (likely something from `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`, e.g. a `useShopperCustomersMutation` with a delete/remove action, or a custom wrapper hook in this same base app). Trace into that hook's own source (check `node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react/` if needed) to see whether it does any optimistic cache update (e.g. `onMutate` in a React Query mutation, manual query-cache manipulation before the network call resolves) or whether it's a plain "await the mutation, then update local state / invalidate queries on success" flow.

3. Report explicitly: is the base implementation optimistic, or does it wait for server confirmation? Is there a visible loading state (spinner, disabled button, opacity change) shown to the shopper while the removal is in flight? Quote the exact evidence.

Report back concisely (under 400 words) with the concrete findings and exact citations. If something genuinely cannot be determined from static code alone, say so plainly rather than guessing.

21	
22	import PageActionPlaceHolder from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/page-action-placeholder'
23	import {HeartIcon} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/icons'
24	import ProductItem from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item'
25	import WishlistPrimaryAction from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/account/wishlist/partials/wishlist-primary-action'
26	import WishlistSecondaryButtonGroup from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/account/wishlist/partials/wishlist-secondary-button-group'
27	
28	import {API_ERROR_MESSAGE} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/constants'
29	import {useCurrentCustomer} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-current-customer'
30	import UnavailableProductConfirmationModal from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/unavailable-product-confirmation-modal'
31	
32	const numberOfSkeletonItems = 3
33	
34	const AccountWishlist = () => {
35	    const navigate = useNavigation()
36	    const {formatMessage} = useIntl()
37	    const toast = useToast()
38	
39	    const headingRef = useRef()
40	    useEffect(() => {
41	        // Focus the 'Wishlist' header when the component mounts for accessibility
42	        headingRef?.current?.focus()
43	    }, [])
44	
45	    const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState(undefined)
46	    const [isWishlistItemLoading, setWishlistItemLoading] = useState(false)
47	
48	    const {data: wishListData, isLoading: isWishListLoading} = useWishList()
49	    const productIds = wishListData?.customerProductListItems?.map((item) => item.productId)
50	
51	    const {data: productsData, isLoading: isProductsLoading} = useProducts(
52	        {
53	            parameters: {
54	                ids: productIds?.join(','),
55	                allImages: true,
56	                perPricebook: true
57	            }
58	        },
59	        {enabled: productIds?.length > 0}
60	    )
61	
62	    // If a product is added to the wishlist many times, it gets collapased into 1 line item
63	    const wishListItems = wishListData?.customerProductListItems?.reduce((itemsData, item) => {
64	        const productData = productsData?.data?.find((product) => product.id === item.productId)
65	        return {...itemsData, [item.productId]: {...item, product: productData}}
66	    }, {})
67	
68	    const updateCustomerProductListItem = useShopperCustomersMutation(
69	        'updateCustomerProductListItem'
70	    )
71	    const deleteCustomerProductListItem = useShopperCustomersMutation(
72	        'deleteCustomerProductListItem'
73	    )
74	
75	    const {data: customer} = useCurrentCustomer()
76	
77	    const handleSecondaryAction = async (itemId, promise) => {
78	        setWishlistItemLoading(true)
79	        setSelectedItem(itemId)
80	
81	        try {
82	            await promise
83	            // No need to handle error here, as the inner component will take care of it
84	        } finally {
85	            setWishlistItemLoading(false)
86	            setSelectedItem(undefined)
87	        }
88	    }
89	
90	    const handleUnavailableProducts = async (unavailableProductIds) => {
91	        if (!unavailableProductIds.length) return
92	        await Promise.all(
93	            unavailableProductIds.map(async (id) => {
94	                const item = wishListItems?.find((item) => {
95	                    return item.productId.toString() === id.toString()
96	                })
97	                const parameters = {
98	                    customerId: customer.customerId,
99	                    itemId: item?.id,
100	                    listId: wishListData?.id
101	                }
102	                await deleteCustomerProductListItem.mutateAsync({parameters})
103	            })
104	        )
105	    }
106	
107	    const handleItemQuantityChanged = async (quantity, item) => {
108	        let isValidChange = false
109	        setSelectedItem(item.productId)
110	
111	        const body = {
112	            ...item,
113	            quantity: parseInt(quantity)
114	        }
115	        // To meet expected schema, remove the custom `product` we added
116	        delete body.product
117	
118	        const parameters = {
119	            customerId: customer.customerId,
120	            itemId: item.id,
121	            listId: wishListData?.id
122	        }
123	
124	        const mutation =
125	            parseInt(quantity) > 0
126	                ? updateCustomerProductListItem.mutateAsync({body, parameters})
127	                : deleteCustomerProductListItem.mutateAsync({parameters})
128	
129	        try {
130	            await mutation
131	            isValidChange = true
132	            setSelectedItem(undefined)
133	        } catch (err) {
134	            toast({
135	                title: formatMessage(API_ERROR_MESSAGE),
136	                status: 'error'
137	            })
138	        }
139	
140	        // If true, the quantity picker would immediately update its number
141	        // without waiting for the invalidated lists data to finish refetching
142	        return isValidChange
143	    }
144	
145	    const hasWishlistItems = Object.keys(wishListItems ?? {}).length > 0
146	    const isPageLoading = hasWishlistItems ? isProductsLoading : isWishListLoading
147	
148	    return (
149	        <Stack spacing={4} data-testid="account-wishlist-page">
150	            <Heading as="h1" fontSize="2xl" tabIndex="0" ref={headingRef}>
151	                <FormattedMessage defaultMessage="Wishlist" id="account_wishlist.title.wishlist" />
152	            </Heading>
153	
154	            {isPageLoading && (
155	                <Box data-testid="sf-wishlist-skeleton">
156	                    {new Array(numberOfSkeletonItems).fill(0).map((i, idx) => (
157	                        <Box
158	                            key={idx}
159	                            p={[4, 6]}
160	                            my={4}
161	                            border="1px solid"
162	                            borderColor="gray.100"
163	                            borderRadius="base"
164	                        >
165	                            <Flex width="full" align="flex-start">
166	                                <Skeleton boxSize={['88px', 36]} mr={4} />
167	
168	                                <Stack spacing={2}>
169	                                    <Skeleton h="20px" w="112px" />
170	                                    <Skeleton h="20px" w="84px" />
171	                                    <Skeleton h="20px" w="140px" />
172	                                </Stack>
173	                            </Flex>
174	                        </Box>
175	                    ))}
176	                </Box>
177	            )}
178	
179	            {!isPageLoading && !hasWishlistItems && (
180	                <PageActionPlaceHolder
181	                    data-testid="empty-wishlist"
182	                    icon={<HeartIcon boxSize={8} />}
183	                    heading={formatMessage({
184	                        defaultMessage: 'No Wishlist Items',
185	                        id: 'account_wishlist.heading.no_wishlist'
186	                    })}
187	                    text={formatMessage({
188	                        defaultMessage: 'Continue shopping and add items to your wishlist.',
189	                        id: 'account_wishlist.description.continue_shopping'
190	                    })}
191	                    buttonText={formatMessage({
192	                        defaultMessage: 'Continue Shopping',
193	                        id: 'account_wishlist.button.continue_shopping'
194	                    })}
195	                    buttonProps={{leftIcon: undefined}}
196	                    onButtonClick={() => navigate('/')}
197	                />
198	            )}
199	
200	            {!isPageLoading &&
201	                wishListItems &&
202	                Object.keys(wishListItems).map((key) => {
203	                    const item = wishListItems[key]
204	                    return (
205	                        <ProductItem
206	                            key={item.id}
207	                            product={{
208	                                ...item.product,
209	                                quantity: item.quantity
210	                            }}
211	                            showLoading={
212	                                (updateCustomerProductListItem.isLoading ||
213	                                    deleteCustomerProductListItem.isLoading ||
214	                                    isWishlistItemLoading) &&
215	                                selectedItem === item.productId
216	                            }
217	                            primaryAction={<WishlistPrimaryAction />}
218	                            onItemQuantityChange={(quantity) =>
219	                                handleItemQuantityChanged(quantity, item)
220	                            }
221	                            secondaryActions={
222	                                <WishlistSecondaryButtonGroup
223	                                    productListItemId={item.id}
224	                                    productName={item.product.name}
225	                                    // Focus to 'Wishlist' header after remove for accessibility
226	                                    focusElementOnRemove={headingRef}
227	                                    onClick={handleSecondaryAction}
228	                                />
229	                            }
230	                        />
231	                    )
232	                })}
233	
234	            <UnavailableProductConfirmationModal
235	                productItems={wishListData?.customerProductListItems}
236	                handleUnavailableProducts={handleUnavailableProducts}
237	            />
238	        </Stack>
239	    )
240	}
241	
242	export default AccountWishlist
